title: Unveiling the role of integrated stress response in pterygium: EGLN3, HSPA8, and NDRG1 as novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
authors: Xiang, Jun; Cheng, Jingyi; Fan, Yidan; Wu, Jiawen; Lyu, Zhaoyuan; Gu, Jiayu; Xu, Jianjiang; Lyu, Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究翼状胬肉中整合应激反应相关生物标志物，虽含TF-mRNA-miRNA网络和分子对接，但核心是疾病生物标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制，方法以转录组和机器学习为主，与TF-DNA结合建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Pterygium was a common progressive ocular disease with unclear pathogenesis. The aim of this study was to identify biomarkers associated with the integrated stress response (ISR) in pterygia and explore the underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified using transcriptome sequencing. ISR-related genes (IRGs) and DEGs were integrated to identify candidate genes, and biomarkers were identified by machine learning. A nomogram was generated using these biomarkers. Enrichment analysis, immune infiltration analysis, correlation analysis, construction of transcription-factor (TF)-mRNA-miRNA regulatory networks, drug prediction, and molecular docking were performed to assess the functional mechanisms underlying these biomarkers. RESULTS: EGLN3, HSPA8, and NDRG1 were identified as ISR-related biomarkers. EGLN3, HSPA8, and NDRG1 were associated with oxidative phosphorylation, cellular response to hypoxia, and decreased oxygen levels according to enrichment analysis. EGLN3 and NDRG1 were significantly and negatively correlated with immune cells, including immature B cells, but not HSPA8. ARNTL-EGLN3-hsa-miR-520a-3p, ARNTL-HSPA8-hsa-miR-520a-3p, and SNAPC4-NDRG1-hsa-miR-518a-5p played regulatory roles in pterygium development. Drug prediction and molecular docking analyses suggested Metribolone and Valproic Acid as potential therapeutic targets for pterygium. According to qRT-PCR, the expressions of EGLN3, HSPA8, and NDRG1 significantly differed between control and pterygium tissues. CONCLUSIONS: EGLN3, HSPA8, and NDRG1 were identified as biomarkers associated with ISR in pterygium. The regulatory networks composed of differed expressions of ISR-related genes, miRNA-mRNA-TF regulatory axes, and immune response played crucial roles in the development of pterygium.
abstract_zh: 目的：翼状胬肉是一种常见的进行性眼病，其发病机制尚不明确。本研究旨在识别与翼状胬肉中整合应激反应（ISR）相关的生物标志物，并探讨其潜在分子机制。方法：通过转录组测序鉴定差异表达基因（DEGs）。整合ISR相关基因（IRGs）与DEGs以识别候选基因，并通过机器学习确定生物标志物。利用这些生物标志物构建列线图。进行富集分析、免疫浸润分析、相关性分析、构建转录因子（TF）-mRNA-miRNA调控网络、药物预测及分子对接，以评估这些生物标志物背后的功能机制。结果：EGLN3、HSPA8和NDRG1被鉴定为ISR相关生物标志物。根据富集分析，EGLN3、HSPA8和NDRG1与氧化磷酸化、细胞对缺氧的反应及氧水平降低相关。EGLN3和NDRG1与免疫细胞（包括未成熟B细胞）显著负相关，但HSPA8除外。ARNTL-EGLN3-hsa-miR-520a-3p、ARNTL-HSPA8-hsa-miR-520a-3p和SNAPC4-NDRG1-hsa-miR-518a-5p在翼状胬肉发展中发挥调控作用。药物预测和分子对接分析提示Metribolone和丙戊酸（Valproic Acid）可能是翼状胬肉的潜在治疗靶点。根据qRT-PCR结果，EGLN3、HSPA8和NDRG1在对照组和翼状胬肉组织中的表达存在显著差异。结论：EGLN3、HSPA8和NDRG1被鉴定为翼状胬肉中与ISR相关的生物标志物。由ISR相关基因差异表达、miRNA-mRNA-TF调控轴及免疫反应组成的调控网络在翼状胬肉发展中发挥关键作用。
